contract.description: With the exponentially increasing need for compute, a new specialized raw material Egg has been developed, the first orders are in!

contract.name: Luncheggbles
contract.description: With school about to resume, pre-made school lunches are ramping production, the top ingredient is Superfood eggs!

contract.name: Bluetooth Pigs
contract.description: (2020) Bluetooth enabled pigs are the new hot pet! Neuro-implant makers need more materials!

contract.name: Antisocial Media
contract.description: A breakthrough Medical Egg based drug cures many mental illnesses simply by making the patient repulsed by social media.

contract.name: Made In Space
contract.description: (2020) A space exploration firm is building a spaceship factory.. in space!

contract.name: The New Mac Pro!
contract.description: (2019) Apple has placed an huge order of Super Material eggs for the crazy new Mac Pro case!

contract.name: Quantum Compost
contract.description: With the leaves falling, compost bins are overflowing, until now. The manufacturers of Quantum Compost bins need supplies!

contract.name: Fusion Frenzy
contract.description: (2021) A recent oil pipeline hijacking has lead to a spike in Fusion Car sales and subsequent fuel demand!

contract.name: Pool Heater
contract.description: (2024) Bright sunshine has folks headed to the pool despite the cool Spring air. Fusion powered Pool Heaters need fuel to combat the frigid water!

contract.name: Folding Screens
contract.description: (2020) While it is unclear who wants a folding screen, at this year's Consumer Electronics Show they were all the rage! Raw materials are needed!

contract.name: Super Merch
contract.description: As vendors strive to be the one stop shop for all their client's merch manufacturing needs, they're needing to lean on more advanced materials.

contract.name: Tricker Treats
contract.description: (2020) Time to help make everyone's favorite Halloween treat!

contract.name: Superfood Mystery
contract.description: (2019) A mysterious company is buying incredible amounts of Superfood Eggs, can you meet the demands?

contract.name: Anti-Tardy
contract.description: Tardies are a thing of the past with these 5 minute literal time savers, you'll never be late to school again!

contract.name: Chocolate!
contract.description: Didn't take scientists long to figure out the smart thing to do was to just make chickens lay chocolate eggs. (2018)

contract.name: Nostalgia
contract.description: July 14 (2018) is Egg Day around the galaxy and everyone like to celebrate with the egg that started it all...

contract.name: heNvidia
contract.description: heNvidia has a new AI chip headed for mass production and they have calibrated their equipment to use egg supplies!

contract.name: Super Food Drive
contract.description: (2018) Egg Farmers have flocked to high value eggs leaving people hungry! We need some Superfood eggs stat!

contract.name: Pumpkin Prep
contract.description: (2019) Halloween looking to be big this year, Pumpkins are sold out and more are needed

contract.name: Carbhen Sequestration
contract.description: An eccentric billionaire is hoarding wood eggs due to their unintended efficient capture and store of carbon!

contract.name: Depleted Reserves
contract.description: (2022) After an extended heat wave, Fusion Egg reserves are nearly depleted, and orders are going out!

contract.name: Fusion Tankers
contract.description: (2018) The world's largest ocean shipping company is putting ultra compact fusion reactors in all their tankers. Long term work available for individual farmers.

contract.name: Chocolate Blast
contract.description: Despite all market research, Chocolate reins supreme as the #1 Halloween Candy, with suppliers scrapping for more, will you help?

contract.name: Just Chocolate
contract.description: (2022) Sometimes chocolate demand spikes, and all we gotta do as egg farmers is make more chocolate. (2018)

contract.name: New Formula
contract.description: (2020) The genetic formula has been tweaked this year leading to record demand for firework eggs this year!

contract.name: Fusion Sauna
contract.description: Self contained Fusion Egg powered saunas are taking off as the evidence of the health benefits of this treatment pile up!

contract.name: Moon Rockets
contract.description: (2019) Moon colony food stores were tainted. The food is ready on earth, just need more fuel!

contract.name: Orbital Colony
contract.description: (2024) Research is being done to create a permanent human colony in orbit of earth. Incredible amounts of Rocket Fuel are needed!

contract.name: Carbon Karts
contract.description: An indoor kart racing league is building their next-gen karts out of CF, and they're looking for a longtime supplier!

contract.name: Small Reactors
contract.description: (2020) The popularity of new compact dilithium reactors are spiking demand for the fuel!

contract.name: LEO Internet
contract.description: (2019) Satellite Constellation Internet is all the rage in commercial space flight! Help fuel the launches!

contract.name: Egg Sandwich
contract.description: This ski season, the popularity of this warm high protein lunch is straining egg supplies. New producers are needed!

contract.name: Pumpkin Crunch
contract.description: (2018) Pumpkins are in super high demand... leave it to the chickens to deliver the goods!

contract.name: Tachyon Deflector
contract.description: (2020) Researchers are developing a device to prevent the adverse effects of deep space travel on the human body.

contract.name: PC Build
contract.description: Desktop PC components are expected to be a huge hit this holiday as the trend of building your own gains momentum!

contract.name: Launch Boom
contract.description: (2022) With insatiable demand for orbital launch services, new providers are reaching for the stars - fuel is needed!

contract.name: Quantum Slopes
contract.description: An innovate ski resort is at it again, this time phase shifting entire runs so a skier or group can appear to have the run to themselves!

contract.name: Leap Year Festival
contract.description: (2019) Leap Year Festivals around the world need Tachyon eggs for various rituals!

contract.name: Snow Energy
contract.description: (2022) With farms everywhere covered in snow, Fusion egg powered snow removal tools are spiking demand for their fuel!

contract.name: Diet Shift
contract.description: (2023) Food suppliers are getting ahead of the diet shift that always comes after Memorial day, and bonuses are being offered for Super Food Egg contracts!

contract.name: Montessori Christmas
contract.description: Montessori toys are trending this year, turns out they are just normal toys but made of wood that cost 4x as much!

contract.name: Moon Storage
contract.description: (2024) A forward space exploration base on the moon is hiring local production of Quantum eggs to sustain their Storage needs.

contract.name: Custom Christmas
contract.description: One-off custom 3d printed Christmas toys are all the rage, and perfectly timed with this new filament egg formula!

contract.name: Ode To Time
contract.description: (2021) On the longest day of the year (northern hemisphere), it has become tradition to celebrate time itself with various Tachyon Egg activities!

contract.name: Tummy Aches
contract.description: (Oct 2019) Kids are eating too much candy after Halloween and it's causing shortages of stomach medication!

contract.name: Quantum Storm
contract.description: Quantum pump technology is being applied at an industrial scale to manage storm flooding, the first test is coming soon!

contract.name: Time Tourism
contract.description: (From Memorial Day 2018) so called "Time Tourism" is booming and Tachyon eggs are in short supply!

contract.name: Inference
contract.description: Big orders for AI chips tailored for inference are being placed for 2026. Fabs need more raw materials!

contract.name: Tooth Saver
contract.description: (2022) A new cavity fighting toothpaste is a huge hit as shoppers try to recover from halloween candy indulgence. Active Ingredient: Medical Eggs

contract.name: Giant TVs
contract.description: The TV size race is seemingly unstoppable, a new technology makes use of Super Material eggs for 120" thermally efficient panels!

contract.name: Hot Chocolate
contract.description: With ski season fully underway and temps dropping, Hot Chocolate is surging in popularity unlike any year before!

contract.name: Choc Shock II
contract.description: (2023) To everyone's surprise, chocolate was the top Father's Day gift this year - depleting supplies - orders are in!
